digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow and blob materialization
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs hang at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours without a job-level timeout, requiring manual cancellation to clear the queue.

Affected Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 omit fix commit 96a0d5c3f and trigger unbounded per-blob lazy-fetch during partial-clone materialization, causing sequential git-fetch RPCs (~2.1 hours for 25,561 files).
_build-and-test.yml reusable workflow test job lacks timeout-minutes configuration and defaults to GitHub's 360-minute limit, allowing stale-ancestry hangs to block hosted runners indefinitely.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignored startAt/maxResults pagination kwargs, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely when invoked through _paged_search on Gerrit 1129.

Repository-level workaround (manual run cancellation) masked two distinct defects: missing job timeout in shared workflow and pagination contract violation in unit test, both requiring separate fixes.
